Three Decades of Packaging, Run by One Family

From pioneers in the PVC leather cloth industry to a modern coated paper and flexible packaging house, K P Packaging has grown across generations while keeping quality and relationships at its core.

A Generational Business

With over three decades of history, K P Packaging is a generational family business. The company is promoted by Mr. Ketan Vira, who, with rich experience in the packaging industry, has grown the business exponentially. Alongside him, his son Mr. Prem Vira has taken it upon himself to take K P Packaging international.

Today we operate across two complementary verticals: in house manufacturing of extrusion coated laminates, and authorized distribution for leading Indian paper mills.

From our state of the art coating and lamination plant in Silvassa to a distribution network spanning India's leading paper mills, we supply pharmaceutical, food, FMCG and medical customers in over 20 countries, the same care across every grade we make and move.

What hasn't changed in three decades is how we work: dependable quality, honest pricing, and long term relationships with the people we package for.

Manufacturing

We manufacture extrusion coated laminates by poly (LDPE) coating printed and unprinted paper, board, aluminium foil, PET, BOPP, fabric and other substrates. Our three state of the art extrusion lamination machines, imported from Korea, China and the United States of America, are supported by an 8 colour rotogravure printing machine and multiple slitting, sheeting and rewinding machines.

Distribution

We are authorized distributors for multiple Indian paper mills, supplying MG Poster, Maplitho, Cupstock, MG/MF Kraft, Greaseproof (OGR), Chromo (C1S & C2S), Glassine, OLB, Bible, Stiffener, Tissue, Duplex, Folding Box Board (FBB), Solid Bleached Sulphate (SBS), Backtite, LWC, Bleach Kraft and more.
